auth-login.name: Login
auth-login.description: Submit credentials; success reaches Dashboard, invalid credentials show an error, transport failure keeps the form usable.

auth-register.name: Register account
auth-register.description: Submit registration for a viewer account; validate duplicate email and password confirmation; show request failure.

dashboard-unauthenticated-redirect.name: Protect dashboard
dashboard-unauthenticated-redirect.description: Open Dashboard without session and reach Login.

dashboard-profile-display.name: View profile
dashboard-profile-display.description: Reach Dashboard after Login and read fixture-backed profile values.

dashboard-logout.name: Logout
dashboard-logout.description: Activate Logout and reach Login with auth cookies cleared.

public-home.name: Home Page
public-home.description: Reach the landing through site navigation and read landing content, including responsive gallery images and the project-video modal.

public-header-navigation.name: Navigate public site
public-header-navigation.description: Use header desktop or mobile navigation to reach a public route or contact anchor.

public-contact-submit.name: Submit contact request
public-contact-submit.description: Complete labeled contact form; valid capture shows success, required fields prevent invalid submission, rejected requests show recoverable error dialog.

auth-session-refresh-contact.name: Refresh session during contact submission
auth-session-refresh-contact.description: Seed stale access_token and valid refresh_token cookies locally; submit contact, renew both tokens on 401, replay unchanged payload and confirm success. Rejected refresh clears cookies and redirects to Login.

public-faq-toggle.name: Read FAQ
public-faq-toggle.description: Activate a question to read its answer and activate again to collapse.

public-gallery-video.name: Watch gallery video
public-gallery-video.description: Open a gallery video card, read the modal player and close using the video close control.

public-brand-video.name: Watch brand video
public-brand-video.description: Open Why Tenndalux video and close modal.

public-products-display.name: Browse products
public-products-display.description: Reach Products through navigation and read static product cards.

public-products-filter.name: Filter products
public-products-filter.description: Choose category and read matching product cards.

public-product-details.name: Read product details
public-product-details.description: Select Ver Detalles, read chosen product details and close modal.

public-services-display.name: Browse services
public-services-display.description: Reach Services and read initial curtain solution.

public-services-tab.name: Switch service solution
public-services-tab.description: Choose Cortinas, Recubrimientos, Exteriores or Tecnología; choose curtain model where offered.

public-services-exterior-mobile-detail.name: Read exterior solution on mobile
public-services-exterior-mobile-detail.description: Open mobile exterior card, read bottom sheet and close by backdrop.

public-blog-list.name: Browse blog
public-blog-list.description: Navigate to Blog, read API-backed cards; failed request settles to no results.

public-blog-filter.name: Filter blog
public-blog-filter.description: Search or choose tag, read matching cards or no results, then clear filters.

public-blog-detail.name: Read article
public-blog-detail.description: Follow article card and read title/content; missing or unavailable article shows return state.

public-blog-share.name: Share article
public-blog-share.description: Activate Compartir using native share or clipboard fallback; rejected browser integration has no visible feedback.

public-portfolio-list.name: Browse portfolio
public-portfolio-list.description: Navigate to Portfolio and read API-backed cards; failed request settles to no results.

public-portfolio-filter.name: Filter portfolio
public-portfolio-filter.description: Choose category, read matching projects or no results, reset to Todos.

public-portfolio-showreel.name: Watch portfolio showreel
public-portfolio-showreel.description: Open showreel, select next or previous video, close overlay.

public-portfolio-detail.name: Read project
public-portfolio-detail.description: Follow project card and read title/content; missing or unavailable project shows return state.
